meta.description: Request a luxury car in Dubai. Nothing is charged online: we confirm on WhatsApp.

picker.label: Choose dates
picker.noticeHint: Greyed-out days are inside this car's {hours}-hour notice period.

rail.label: Next 30 days
rail.tapStart: Tap a day to move your pickup.

time.oohHint: Handovers between 22:00 and 08:00 cost AED {fee} extra each.

phone.hint: We'll message you about this request on this number.

quote.caption: Price breakdown
quote.deposit: Refundable deposit, held on your card at handover
quote.depositNote: A hold, not a payment. Released {days} days after return, less any fines or tolls.
quote.noDeposit: No security deposit for chauffeur bookings.
quote.km: {km} km included, then AED {fee} per km
quote.onRequest: Price on request: our concierge confirms the final price.
quote.nothingCharged: Nothing is charged on this website.
quote.pending: Choose dates to see your total

reserve.requestNote: Bugatti requests are priced by our concierge. You'll see the full quote before anything is confirmed.
reserve.noCharge: Free to request. Nothing is charged online.
reserve.collectNote: Collect and return at our Dubai Silicon Oasis office at no charge.

packages.airportDetail: DXB or DWC to anywhere in Dubai, one way

dock.label: Plan your trip
dock.replies: We reply on WhatsApp, usually within 1 hour, 09:00–22:00.
dock.repliesOoh: Replies from 09:00. You can still send your request now.

flow.finishWhatsAppHint: Prefer to chat? We'll send everything you've entered so far.
flow.oohNotice: It's outside our reply hours. You can still send your request: we reply from 09:00, and requests are answered in the order they arrive.
flow.noCarLede: Pick one of our most requested cars, or browse the whole fleet.
flow.requestOnlyText: Your request is free. We check availability and confirm on WhatsApp before anything is charged.

trip.addressHint: You can also send this on WhatsApp later.
trip.flightHint: We track your flight, so a delay doesn't cost you. Example: EK 202
trip.dsoText: Collect and return at our office at no charge. We send the exact location on WhatsApp.
trip.phantomNote: The Phantom is chauffeur-driven by default. Self-drive needs our team's approval and a driver aged 30 or over.
trip.zoneFreeFrom: AED {fee} each way, free from {days} days

extras.standardDetail: Comprehensive insurance. You pay up to {excess} per claim.
extras.fullCoverDetail: Lowers your excess to {excess}. Also covers tyres, rims and glass.
extras.fullCoverDetailZero: No excess to pay. Also covers tyres, rims and glass.
extras.driversHint: AED {fee} per driver per day. Each driver must meet the same age and licence rules.
extras.seatsHint: Free on request. Tell us the ages on WhatsApp.
extras.chauffeurNote: Your chauffeur, fuel, tolls, water and Wi-Fi are included. Add child seats if you need them.

driver.name: Full name
driver.nameHint: As it appears on the driving licence.
driver.emailHint: For a copy of your request.
driver.resident: Do you live in the UAE?
driver.idp: Bring an International Driving Permit (IDP) with your home licence. Visitors with a licence from this country need one in the UAE.
driver.idpOk: Visitors can drive on a licence from this country. Bring the original.
driver.residentLicence: UAE residents must drive on a valid UAE driving licence.
driver.ageHint: You also need a full licence held for at least {years} years.
driver.notesHint: Hotel, occasion, special requests. Please don't send ID or card numbers here.
driver.documentsText: We ask for your licence and passport or Emirates ID on WhatsApp after you send the request, and check the originals at handover. We never keep your passport.
driver.privacy: We use these details only to handle this request.
driver.selfDriveAlt: Prefer not to drive? Book a chauffeur instead.

errors.name: Enter your full name.
errors.phoneUaeMobile: Enter a UAE mobile number starting with 5, for example 50 123 4567.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, including the area or mobile code.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.emailRequired: Enter your email address, or choose WhatsApp or a phone call.
errors.flight: Enter a flight number like EK 202.
errors.under25: Sorry, the main driver must be 25 or older to drive our cars. Our chauffeur service has no age limit.
errors.minAge: The main driver must be {age} or older for this car.
errors.residentLicence: UAE residents need a UAE driving licence to rent. Choose "United Arab Emirates", or tell us more on WhatsApp.
errors.ack: Tick to confirm you've read the Privacy Notice and Rental Requirements.
errors.whatsappConsent: Tick to let us message you on WhatsApp, or choose another way to reply on the driver step.

review.name: Name
review.fees: Fuel, tolls (Salik, AED 4 to AED 6 per crossing plus AED 1) and fines are charged after the rental, as set out in the Rental Requirements.
review.ack: I have read the {privacy} and {requirements}. I understand my booking is confirmed only when Luxuryrentals confirms it.
review.whatsappConsent: Luxuryrentals may message me on WhatsApp at this number about this request.
review.marketing: Send me offers and new arrivals by WhatsApp and email. I can opt out at any time.
review.next1: We store your request and give you a reference.
review.next2: Confirm on WhatsApp. We check the car and your documents, then confirm.
review.next3: Pay an advance by secure link, or at handover. The deposit is held on your card at handover.
review.failText: Your details are saved on this device. Try again, or send everything to us on WhatsApp.
review.nudge: Still deciding? You can send these details to us on WhatsApp and finish there.
review.missing: Some details are missing. Fix them before sending:
review.demoFail: Demo: this page will simulate a network error on the first try.

confirmed.title: Request received, not yet confirmed
confirmed.lede: Your reference is {ref}. Send it to us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm availability.
confirmed.whatsappHint: Opens WhatsApp with your request. Or message {number} with your reference.
confirmed.t1Text: We've stored your request and alerted our team.
confirmed.t2Text: We check the car, your dates and documents.
confirmed.t2TextOoh: We're back at 09:00, and requests are answered in the order they arrive.
confirmed.t3Text: Pay the advance by secure link or at handover. The deposit is held on your card at handover.
confirmed.demoHint: Demo: open the ops view to confirm this request as the Luxuryrentals team.
confirmed.unknown: We can't show the details of this request on this device, but your reference is still valid.
confirmed.reply: We reply on WhatsApp, usually within 1 hour, 09:00–22:00.

status.title: Your booking request
status.lookupLede: Enter the reference from your confirmation, for example LR-7K3QZM.
status.notFound: We couldn't find {ref} on this device. In this demo, requests are stored in your browser only.

text.requested: Request received, not yet confirmed. Send your reference on WhatsApp and we'll confirm availability.
text.confirmed: Luxuryrentals has confirmed your booking. Pay the advance to secure it, or pay at handover.
text.declined: Sorry, this car isn't available for these dates. Choose another car or ask us on WhatsApp for alternatives.
text.awaiting_payment: We've sent you a payment link for the advance.
text.paid: Advance received. The balance is due at handover, and the deposit is held on your card then.
text.expired: This request expired before it was confirmed.

status.cancelText: Requests are free to cancel before we confirm. After confirmation, any advance is refunded under our cancellation policy.
status.cancelNote: Cancelled by the customer on the website
status.live: Updates live when our team changes the status.

pay.banner: Demo payment: no card details are collected and nothing is charged.
pay.bannerText: On the live site, payment happens on our payment provider's secure page after we confirm your booking.
pay.title: Pay your advance
pay.advanceNote: 25% of the total, at least one day's rental.
pay.fullNote: Chauffeur bookings are paid in full.
pay.deposit: Refundable deposit, held on your card at handover
pay.failed: Payment failed (simulated). Nothing was charged. You can try again.
pay.notPayable: This request isn't waiting for payment.
pay.notPayableText: Payment opens once Luxuryrentals confirms your booking. Current status: {status}.
pay.notFound: We couldn't find this request on this device.

ops.title: Ops desk
ops.lede: This page simulates the Luxuryrentals team's side. In production, ops get an email for every new request with one-click Confirm and Decline links, and later an ops console like this one. Changes here update the customer's status page live, in any tab.
ops.emptyHint: Send a request from any car page, or create a sample one.
ops.resetText: This clears all demo requests stored in this browser. It can't be undone.

notes.declined: Declined by ops: not available on these dates
notes.awaiting_payment: Payment link sent to the customer (simulated)

ops.emailIntro: A new booking request came in from the website. Reply to the customer on WhatsApp, then confirm or decline.
ops.emailNote: In production these links open a confirmation page; the change happens only when you press the button there.
